# Packt Subscription

> Packt Subscription is a comprehensive learning platform offering 7,500+ eBooks and videos on AI agents, large language models, RAG systems, and modern tech skills.

This site provides in-depth technical content on building AI agents with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and knowledge graphs. The collection emphasizes practical implementation using frameworks like PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and LangChain.

## Key Topics

- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- AI Agents
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Knowledge Graphs
- Transformer Architecture
- Deep Learning
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- LangChain
- PyTorch
- Self-Attention Mechanisms
- Reinforcement Learning
- Streamlit
- Hugging Face Transformers
- Text Processing
- Multi-Agent Systems

## LLM Foundations & Architecture

- [Part 1: The AI Agent Engine: From Text to Large Language Models](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/1): Detailed chapter on Transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, and LLM foundations
- [Chapter 2: The Transformer: The Model Behind the Modern AI Revolution](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/3): Deep dive into Transformer architecture, self-attention, and NLP fundamentals
- [Chapter 1: Analyzing Text Data with Deep Learning](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/2): Guide to text analysis techniques including Bag of Words and TF-IDF methods
- [Chapter 3: Exploring LLMs as a Powerful AI Engine](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/4): Tutorial on LLM engines using PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and technical setup

## AI Agents & RAG Systems

- [Part 2: AI Agents and Retrieval of Knowledge](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/5): Introduction to AI agents, RAG systems, and Knowledge Graphs integration
- [Chapter 5: Extending Your Agent with RAG to Prevent Hallucinations](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/7): Tutorial on RAG systems and hallucination prevention in AI agents
- [Chapter 6: Advanced RAG Techniques for Information Retrieval and Augmentation](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/8): Advanced RAG techniques for improved information retrieval and LLM augmentation
- [Chapter 4: Building a Web Scraping Agent with an LLM](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/6): How-to guide for building web scraping agents using LangChain and PyTorch

## Knowledge Graphs & Advanced Techniques

- [Chapter 7: Creating and Connecting a Knowledge Graph to an AI Agent](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/9): Guide to Knowledge Graph construction and integration with AI agents
- [Chapter 8: Reinforcement Learning and AI Agents](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/10): Tutorial on deep reinforcement learning, policy learning, and neural networks

## Building Production AI Systems

- [Part 3: Creating Sophisticated AI to Solve Complex Scenarios](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/11): Part 3 on sophisticated AI systems using Streamlit, Docker, and multi-agent orchestration
- [Chapter 9: Creating Single- and Multi-Agent Systems](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/12): Guide to building single and multi-agent systems with travel planning examples
- [Chapter 10: Building an AI Agent Application](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/13): Tutorial on building Streamlit-based AI agent applications with multi-agent systems

## Reference & Resources

- [Index | Building AI Agents with LLMs, RAG, and Knowledge Graphs](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/data/9781835087060/16): Comprehensive index for AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and Knowledge Graphs topics
- [Packt Subscription | Advance your knowledge in tech](https://subscription.packtpub.com): Packt subscription service offering 7,500+ eBooks and videos on programming, AI, and tech skills
